authority_normalization_falsification.reason: The validator coerces authority_label with String(...).toUpperCase() and rejects only three exact denylist strings. It does not trim, require string type, or reject unknown/non-canonical authority labels, so ambiguous authority-bearing payloads can validate ok=true. Under Prometeo's fail-closed authority boundary this is candidate-hardening evidence, not promotion authority.
